manifest.name: dsh-file-extension
manifest.description: 文件操作功能扩展：为 DeepSeek Harness 右侧栏文件条目补全 Trae 风格操作（在文件管理器中显示、添加到对话、另存为、复制路径、重命名、回收站删除），并与电脑其他位置双向复制粘贴文件和文件夹
manifest.author: badwoo

readme.text:
中文 | [English](README.en.md)

为 [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) 网页版与桌面版的
**右侧栏文件树**补全 Trae 风格的文件操作：右键任意文件弹出自制上下文菜单，悬停任意条目
浮现一键 **@** 按钮，删除默认移入**操作系统回收站**而不是直接销毁文件。文件与文件夹可以
与电脑上的其他位置**双向复制粘贴**。

> **状态：** 已在 dsh `0.2.2-rc.1`（Windows 11，网页版与桌面版）实机验证。见[兼容性](#兼容性)。

```
┌───────────────────────────────────┐
│ 🔍  在文件资源管理器中显示         │
│ @   添加到对话                    │
│ ↗   在新标签页中打开              │

使用 dsh 主题令牌绘制，因此自动跟随浅色 / 深色主题。
目录条目显示同一菜单但去掉「添加到对话」「在新标签页中打开」「另存为」，
并增加「新建文件」「新建文件夹」「粘贴到此处」。

---

- [功能](#功能)
- [安装](#安装)
- [卸载](#卸载)
- [兼容性](#兼容性)
- [网页版与桌面版差异](#网页版与桌面版差异)
- [已知限制](#已知限制)
- [接线说明](#接线说明)
- [开发](#开发)
- [验证清单](#验证清单)
- [许可证](#许可证)

---

| 菜单项 | 行为 |
|---|---|
| **在文件资源管理器中显示** | 在 Finder / 资源管理器 / 桌面文件管理器中定位并选中该文件。宿主不支持时置灰并给出 tooltip。 |
| **添加到对话** | 在输入框光标处插入一个**高亮的引用 chip**（官方 `@` 源的原子引用，不是纯文本）。chip 插入即为完成态，**不会弹出补全菜单、无需按 Tab**；点击 chip 在右侧栏预览该文件；发送时序列化为规范的 `@路径`（含空格路径自动加引号，目录带尾斜杠）。 |
| **新建文件 / 新建文件夹**（仅目录） | 在该文件夹内创建新条目。名称经对话框收集，宿主校验；同名或非法名会保留对话框并显示原因。 |
| **在新标签页中打开** | 在右侧面板的预览区新标签页中打开该文件。 |
| **另存为…** | 以新文件名、新目录写出副本，默认名为 `原名-副本.扩展名`。**绝不修改原文件**；同名时先询问是否覆盖。 |
| **复制绝对路径** | 复制完整路径并给出 toast。 |
| **复制相对路径** | 复制相对工作区的路径并给出 toast。 |
| **复制到…** | 把文件或**整个文件夹**复制到电脑上的任意位置：先用宿主原生目录对话框选定目标文件夹，再写出副本。同名冲突默认**保留两者**（`原名 (2).扩展名`），也可选覆盖或跳过。 |
| **复制文件** | 把条目放到**操作系统剪贴板**（真正的文件拖放列表 `CF_HDROP`，不是文本），因此可以直接到资源管理器 / Finder 里 `Ctrl+V` 粘贴。 |
| **粘贴到此处** | 把**操作系统剪贴板**里的文件或文件夹复制进当前目录。剪贴板为空时置灰。同样默认保留两者，不覆盖。 |
| **重命名** | 在条目上原地弹出输入框，并选中主文件名。`Enter` **或点击其他区域**确认、`Esc` 取消。 |
| **删除** | **将文件移动到操作系统回收站**，并在确认框中明确说明。仅当宿主确实无法访问回收站时，才降级为永久删除并改用红色警示文案。 |
| **检查更新…** | 读取本插件当前版本，查询 GitHub 最新 Release 并做语义化版本比较；可交由 harness 的 pluginManager 就地更新，或给出可复制的更新命令。 |

菜单行为：点击外部或 `Esc` 关闭，支持 `↑`/`↓`/`Home`/`End` 键盘导航并跳过置灰项，
在视口任意边缘自动翻转，不会溢出。

文件树的根目录**没有自己的行**。在条目下方的**空白区域**右键，会打开一个精简菜单：
**新建文件**、**新建文件夹**、**粘贴到此处**与**检查更新…**。新建的条目落在工作区根目录，
根路径取自树容器自身的 `data-files-root` 属性。

> **dsh 版本差异：** `0.2.1` 及更早的树顶部有一条标题栏，其中显示根路径标签；
> `0.2.2` 起该标题栏已被移除，因此插件改为只依赖容器上的 `data-files-root`。
> 插件本来就不依赖标题栏，但早期文档曾描述过它，这里据实更正。

鼠标悬停任意文件条目时，其右侧浮现一个 `@` 按钮，带「添加到对话」tooltip。
按钮是**覆盖**在条目上的，不插入行内，因此长文件名仍保持省略号截断、条目不会重排。
点击等效于菜单中的「添加到对话」：插入一个高亮、可点击的引用 chip。

目录条目提供**在文件资源管理器中显示**、**新建文件**、**新建文件夹**、
**复制到…**、**复制文件**、**粘贴到此处**、**复制绝对路径**、**复制相对路径**、
**重命名**、**删除文件夹**。
删除文件夹时会说明将整个目录移入回收站，并要求二次确认。

readme.section: 与电脑其他位置双向复制
readme.text:
文件树与电脑上的任意位置之间可以双向搬运文件，两个方向都有：

| 方向 | 菜单项 | 实现 |
|---|---|---|
| 文件树 → 指定文件夹 | **复制到…** | 宿主原生目录对话框选目标，递归复制（文件夹可整体复制） |
| 文件树 → 系统剪贴板 | **复制文件** | 写入操作系统剪贴板为**文件拖放列表**，可在资源管理器 / Finder 中粘贴 |
| 系统剪贴板 → 文件树 | **粘贴到此处** | 读取剪贴板中的文件列表，递归复制进当前目录 |

三条规则值得明确，因为它们决定了这个功能**不会**变成任意读写的后门：

readme.section: 与电脑其他位置双向复制
readme.text:
1. **源必须在工作区内。「复制到…」的源**必须位于当前会话工作区内，因此这个路由无法
   被用来读取页面本来无权读取的文件。目标位置则不受限制——那正是功能本身。
2. **目标必须在工作区内。「粘贴到此处」的目标**必须在工作区内，因此页面无法借它往
   工作区以外写文件。源来自用户自己放进剪贴板的内容。
3. **只允许本机调用。** 四个剪贴板 / 传输路由都要求请求来自宿主本机回环地址
   （与「检查更新」的就地更新同一规则）。剪贴板是**整机共享**资源，不是工作区资源：
   远程网页会话既不应能窥探宿主剪贴板，也不应能触发复制。此外 `clipboard-read`
   **从响应中剔除纯文本**，只返回文件列表，避免这条路由变成读取任意剪贴板文本的通道。

冲突处理默认**保留两者**（`原名 (2).扩展名`），与资源管理器一致，绝不默认覆盖；
也可在对话框中显式选择覆盖或跳过。部分成功是正常结果：跳过的条目会逐条报告原因
（文件已消失、被占用、超过体积上限、同名跳过），界面会如实说明「复制了 N 个、跳过 M 个」，
而不是谎报全部成功。

- 所有文件操作完成后状态保持一致：文件树通过自身的目录监听自动刷新；删除正在预览的
  文件时会同时关闭其预览标签。
- 界面文案中英双语，跟随 dsh 的 locale 服务。
- 插件卸载或热更新时，菜单、按钮、对话框、样式、事件监听、`MutationObserver`
  与所有 slot 注册都会被完整清理。

---

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add github:badwoo/dsh-file-extension
```

随后重启 harness，并在浏览器中硬刷新（`Ctrl+Shift+R`）。

**桌面版：** 桌面 profile 由 Electron 应用独占管理，`dsh plugin --profile desktop`
会拒绝操作。请通过应用内的 **设置 → 插件 → 添加** 安装，或手动把包加入桌面 profile
的 `package.json` 与 `dsh.profile.bundles` 后重启应用。

```bash
git clone https://github.com/badwoo/dsh-file-extension.git
cd dsh-file-extension
dsh plugin --profile web add "$(pwd)"
```

`lib/` 已随仓库提交，安装时无需本地构建。

---

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-file-extension
```

重启 harness 并硬刷新浏览器。不会留下任何残留：没有路由、没有样式标签、没有监听器。
可这样确认：

```js
// 浏览器控制台
document.querySelector('style[data-plugin="dsh-file-extension"]')  // null
```

```bash
curl -i http://127.0.0.1:端口/api/dsh-file-extension/capabilities   # 404
```

---

| dsh 版本 | 桌面版（Electron） | 网页版 | 说明 |
|---|---|---|---|
| `0.2.2-rc.1` | ✅ 已验证 | ✅ 已验证 | Windows 11；本版本的目标版本，浏览器 E2E 全绿 |
| `0.2.1-rc.2` | ✅ 已验证 | ✅ 已验证 | 上一版本的目标版本 |
| 其他 `0.2.x` | ⚠️ 预期可用 | ⚠️ 预期可用 | 依赖下表中的 `data-files-*` 行属性 |

插件只从官方界面读取三个属性。若未来版本改名，菜单与悬停按钮会**静默失效而不是报错**，
修复只需改 `src/client/controller.js` 里的一行常量：

| 属性 | 归属包 | 用途 |
|---|---|---|
| `data-files-entry` | `dsh-client-ui-sidebar-files` | `file` / `directory` / `other` |
| `data-files-path` | `dsh-client-ui-sidebar-files` | 该行的绝对路径 |
| `data-sidebar-right-session` | `dsh-client-ui-sidebar-right` | 面板当前显示的会话 |

根目录空白区与根路径另用树容器自身的两个属性，同样稳定：
`data-files-state="tree"`、`data-files-root`、`data-files-body`。

> **`0.2.2` 的适配要点：** 该版本移除了文件树顶部的标题栏（含 `data-path-label`），
> 并新增了官方的 `contextMenus` 服务。插件不依赖前者（根路径取自容器），
> 也因此不受影响；后者是可选的替代路径，插件目前仍使用自绘菜单，
> 因为自绘菜单不引入对新服务的硬依赖，在 `0.2.1` 上也能工作。

---

插件运行在浏览器中，但所有文件系统操作都在**宿主机器**上通过
`/api/dsh-file-extension/*` 路由执行。因此「能否显示 / 另存 / 回收站」取决于**宿主**，
而不是浏览器所在机器。

| 功能 | 桌面版 | 网页版（宿主同机） | 网页版（宿主在别处） |
|---|---|---|---|
| 在文件资源管理器中显示 | ✅ 原生 | ✅ 经宿主的桌面打开器 | ❌ 置灰并给出 tooltip |
| 添加到对话 | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ |
| 在新标签页中打开 | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ |
| 另存为 | ✅ 原生目录选择 + 宿主写盘 | ✅ 原生目录选择 + 宿主写盘 | ⬇️ 降级为浏览器下载（上限 32 MiB，超出先提示大小） |
| 复制路径 | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ |
| 重命名 | ✅ 宿主文件系统 | ✅ 宿主文件系统 | ✅ 宿主文件系统 |
| 删除 | ♻️ 回收站 | ♻️ 回收站 | ♻️ 取决于宿主操作系统 |

**另存为**的对话框由插件自绘：文件名与**目标文件夹**都是可直接编辑的输入框，右侧的
「选择…」按钮调用宿主自己的目录对话框（桌面版是原生文件夹对话框）。若宿主的对话框没有
响应（被窗口遮挡，或宿主是纯网页版），按钮会立刻显示「等待宿主响应…」，30 秒后给出明确
提示，此时直接输入文件夹路径即可——留空则保存在原文件旁边。因此即使宿主对话框不可用，
另存为也始终可用。

| 平台 | 实现方式 | 验证状态 |
|---|---|---|
| Windows | PowerShell 调用 `Microsoft.VisualBasic.FileIO.FileSystem` 的 `SendToRecycleBin` | ✅ 文件与目录均确认出现在 `D:\$Recycle.Bin` 中 |
| macOS | 优先 `trash` CLI，否则用 Finder AppleScript | 本机未测试 |
| Linux | FreeDesktop Trash 规范（`~/.local/share/Trash` + `.trashinfo`） | 本机未测试 |

当回收站确实不可达时，插件**不会静默删除**：它会用红色警示文案
「该操作将永久删除，不可恢复。」重新打开确认框，并要求二次明确确认。

---

1. **依赖 DOM 契约。** dsh 的文件树没有行级扩展点，插件依附于
   [兼容性](#兼容性)中列出的三个行属性。这是唯一的耦合面，且刻意收窄。
2. **行内重命名是覆盖层。** 输入框绝对定位覆盖在条目上（官方条目无法承载注入的组件），
   会跟随条目滚动与刷新；条目消失时自动关闭。
3. **回收站在宿主侧。** 删除发生在运行宿主进程的机器上，不是运行浏览器的机器。
4. **下载上限。** 浏览器下载降级默认拒绝超过 32 MiB 的文件（插件配置项
   `maxDownloadBytes`）。
5. **显示功能依赖 `open-in-app`。** 若某部署未挂载 `session.openWorkspacePath`
   这个 Remote，「在文件资源管理器中显示」会保持置灰。
6. **极小概率竞态。** 宿主会拒绝覆盖已存在的目标，但在检查与写入之间新建的文件仍可能
   被系统级复制覆盖。这与任何保存对话框的窗口期相同。
7. **检查更新需要能直连 GitHub。** 若宿主机器有 TLS 拦截代理（企业网络常见），
   Node 内置的 CA 包可能无法验证 `api.github.com`。插件会**自动改用操作系统证书存储
   重试一次**（仍然做完整校验，绝不关闭验证），因此在系统已信任该代理根证书的机器上
   通常无需任何额外配置即可成功。只有当系统也不信任时，检查才会以可读的错误收场
   （不崩溃、不静默），此时可设置 `NODE_EXTRA_CA_CERTS` 指向企业根证书。

> **检查失败绝不等同于「已是最新」。** 这是一个曾经真实发生的缺陷：失败响应里
   > 写死了 `hasUpdate: false`，界面据此显示「当前已是最新版本」，把
   > 「无法确定」误报成「不需要更新」，正好隐瞒了用户需要知道的失败本身。
   > 现在失败会返回 `hasUpdate: null` / `checked: false`，界面显示
   > 「检查未能完成，因此无法确定是否有新版本」，并附上失败原因。
8. **就地更新取决于部署。** 更新操作交由 harness 的 pluginManager 执行；在
   pluginManager 不可用或拒绝（例如热重载服务活跃、包被进程占用）时，对话框会给出
   可直接复制的命令而不是谎报成功。
9. **匿名 GitHub API 限流。** 检查更新使用 GitHub 公共 API，未带令牌时每小时仅 60 次
   （按出口 IP 计）。反复点「重新检查」可能触发限流；此时对话框会明确显示
   「GitHub 拒绝了请求（HTTP 403）——已触发 API 限流，请稍后再试」，
   而不会把它当作「已是最新」。

`cordis.patch.yml` 插入一条 loader 行：

```yaml
- insert:
    - id: dsh-file-extension
      name: dsh-file-extension
```

`package.json` 用 `dsh.bundle.patch` 指向它，因此 `dsh plugin add` 一步完成
依赖安装 + loader 注册。

| 字段 | 值 | 作用 |
|---|---|---|
| `exports["."]` | `./lib/index.js` | loader 会 `import()` 包根来加载 Host 半边 |
| `exports["./client"]` | `./lib/client.js` | 浏览器模块系统按此提供客户端 bundle |
| `dsh.bundle.patch` | `./cordis.patch.yml` | 让该包成为 bundle |
| `dsh.client.platform` | `web` | 声明为浏览器插件 |
| `dsh.client.immediately` | `true` | 启动即加载，而非首次使用时 |
| `dsh.client.inject` | slots / sidebar-right / conversation / locale / remotes / session-controller | 仅用于激活顺序 |
| `files` | `lib/`、补丁、locale、图标、README、LICENSE | 控制发布包体积 |
| `peerDependencies` | 所有 `@deepseek-ai/*` 与 `react` | 不重复打包宿主已有的模块 |

该行落在 profile 由 `cordis.patch.yml` 组合出的树中。可这样确认：

```bash
dsh --profile web --dump-config | grep -A2 "dsh-file-extension"
```

| 组成 | 位置 | 生命周期 |
|---|---|---|
| Host 路由 `/api/dsh-file-extension/*` | `ctx.effect` 内的 `ctx.webServer.register` | 卸载即移除 |
| 上下文菜单、对话框、toast | `shell.overlay` slot | 卸载即移除 |
| 输入框 `inputActions` 捕获 | `conversation.input.dock` slot | 卸载即移除 |
| 行监听 + `MutationObserver` | `document`，包在 `ctx.effect` 内 | 卸载即移除 |
| 样式表 | 一个 `<style data-plugin="dsh-file-extension">` | 卸载即移除 |
| 语言词典 | `ctx.locale.register` | 卸载即移除 |

每条路由都用 `ctx.connection.requestRejection` 鉴权，因此插件路由与官方路由同样受保护：
未鉴权请求返回 `401`。

---

```bash
npm install          # 仅需 esbuild
node build.mjs       # src/ -> lib/
```

`src/host/` 是普通 ES 模块。`src/client/` 打包为 CommonJS 后包进
`window.__ModuleLoader__.load({ id, factory })`，因为浏览器模块系统只注册工厂函数。
`react` 与平台模块表保持外部引用。

```
src/host/
  index.js       apply()、Config、HTTP 路由、鉴权
  contract.js    共享错误码、文件名校验、副本命名
  fsops.js       stat / rename / create / remove / copy / download

两套测试都驱动真实环境，需要一个运行中的实例：

```bash

readme.section: 浏览器：加载页面、右键真实条目、走完每个对话框
readme.text:
$env:DSH_TEST_URL="http://127.0.0.1:端口/?token=..."
$env:DSH_TEST_CHROME="C:\Program Files\Google\Chrome\Application\chrome.exe"

Trae-style file actions for the **right Sidebar file tree** of the
[DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) Web UI and
desktop app: right-click any file for a themed context menu, hover any row for a
one-click **@** button, and delete into the operating system's recycle bin
instead of destroying files. Files and folders copy **both ways** between the
tree and anywhere else on the computer.

> **Status:** verified on dsh `0.2.2-rc.1` (Windows 11, Web and Desktop). See
> [Compatibility](#compatibility).

```
┌───────────────────────────────────┐
│ 🔍  Reveal in File Manager        │
│ @   Add to Conversation           │
│ ↗   Open in New Tab               │

Drawn with the harness theme tokens, so it follows light and dark themes.
Directory rows show the same menu minus **Add to Conversation**, **Open in New
Tab**, and **Save As**, plus **New File**, **New Folder**, and **Paste Here**.

Right-click any file in the right Sidebar's file tree. The plugin draws its own
menu — never the native one — using the harness theme tokens, so it matches the
active light or dark theme.

| Row | What it does |
|---|---|
| **Reveal in File Manager** | Selects the file in Finder / Explorer / the desktop file manager. Greyed out with a tooltip when the host cannot open one. |
| **Add to Conversation** | Inserts `@path` at the composer caret without replacing the existing draft. Paths with spaces use the quoted `@"path"` form. |
| **Open in New Tab** | Opens the file in a new right-panel preview tab. |
| **Save As…** | Writes a copy under a new name and folder. Defaults to `name-copy.ext` / `名称-副本.ext`. Never modifies the source. Asks before overwriting. |
| **Copy Absolute Path** | Copies the full path, with a toast. |
| **Copy Relative Path** | Copies the workspace-relative path, with a toast. |
| **Copy To…** | Copies the file — or a **whole folder** — to anywhere on the computer. A native folder dialog picks the destination, then a copy is written. Name collisions keep **both** by default (`name (2).ext`); overwrite and skip are also offered. |
| **Copy Files** | Puts the entry on the **operating system clipboard** as a real file drop list (`CF_HDROP`, not text), so it can be pasted straight into Explorer / Finder. |
| **Paste Here** | Copies files or folders from

Menu behaviour: closes on outside click and on `Esc`, navigates with
`↑`/`↓`/`Home`/`End`, skips disabled rows, and flips itself back inside the
viewport at every edge.

Hovering any file row reveals a small `@` button at its right edge, with an
"Add to conversation" tooltip. It is positioned over the row rather than
inserted into it, so long file names keep their ellipsis and the row does not
reflow. Clicking it is identical to the menu's **Add to Conversation**.

Directories get **Reveal**, **New File**, **New Folder**, **Copy To…**,
**Copy Files**, **Paste Here**, **Copy Absolute Path**, **Copy Relative Path**,
**Rename**, and **Delete Folder**. Deleting a folder says that the whole folder
is moved to the recycle bin and asks for confirmation first.

readme.section: Two-way copy with the rest of the computer
readme.text:
| Direction | Menu row | How it works |
|---|---|---|
| Tree → a chosen folder | **Copy To…** | Native folder dialog picks the target, then a recursive copy (whole folders included) |
| Tree → system clipboard | **Copy Files** | Writes a **file drop list** to the OS clipboard, pasteable in Explorer / Finder |
| System clipboard → tree | **Paste Here** | Reads the clipboard's file list and copies it recursively into this directory |

readme.section: Two-way copy with the rest of the computer
readme.text:
Three rules are worth stating, because they are what stop this from becoming a
read-write back door:

readme.section: Two-way copy with the rest of the computer
readme.text:
1. **Copy To… sources stay inside the workspace.** The route can never be used to
   read a file the page was not already allowed to read. The destination is
   free-form — that is the feature.
2. **Paste Here destinations stay inside the workspace.** The page cannot use it
   to write outside the workspace. Sources come from what the user themselves put
   on the clipboard.
3. **Loopback only.** All four clipboard/transfer routes require the request to
   come from the host machine itself (the same rule the in-place update already
   used). The clipboard is a **machine-wide** resource, not a workspace one: a
   remote browser session should be able to neither inspect it nor trigger a
   copy. `clipboard-read` additionally **strips the plain-text flavour** and
   returns only the file list, so the route cannot double as a way to read
   arbitrary clipboard text.

readme.section: Two-way copy with the rest of the computer
readme.text:
Collisions keep **both** by default (`name (2).ext`), matching a file manager,
and never overwrite silently; overwrite and skip are explicit choices. Partial
success is a normal outcome: skipped entries are reported one by one (vanished,
locked, over the size cap, name skipped), and the UI says "copied N, skipped M"
rather than claiming everything worked.

- Every mutation leaves the tree consistent: the file tree refreshes itself
  through its own directory watches, and deleting a file that is currently
  previewed closes that preview tab.
- All copy is bilingual (English / 简体中文) and follows the harness locale
  service.
- Unloading or hot-reloading the plugin removes its menu, button, dialogs,
  stylesheet, document listeners, `MutationObserver`, and slot registrations.

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add github:badwoo/dsh-file-extension
```

Then restart the harness and hard-refresh the browser (`Ctrl+Shift+R`).

**Desktop app:** the desktop profile is managed by the Electron application and
`dsh plugin --profile desktop` refuses to touch it. Install through
**Settings → Plugins → Add** in the app, or add the package to the desktop
profile's `package.json` and `dsh.profile.bundles` and restart the app.

```bash
git clone https://github.com/badwoo/dsh-file-extension.git
cd dsh-file-extension
dsh plugin --profile web add "$(pwd)"
```

`lib/` is committed, so no build step is required to install.

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-file-extension
```

Restart the harness and hard-refresh the browser. Nothing is left behind: no
routes, no stylesheet tag, no listeners. To confirm, check that
`document.querySelector('style[data-plugin="dsh-file-extension"]')` is `null` and
that `/api/dsh-file-extension/capabilities` returns `404`.

| dsh version | Desktop (Electron) | Web | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `0.2.2-rc.1` | ✅ verified | ✅ verified | Windows 11; this release's target, browser E2E fully green |
| `0.2.1-rc.2` | ✅ verified | ✅ verified | the previous release's target |
| other `0.2.x` | ⚠️ expected | ⚠️ expected | Depends on the `data-files-*` row attributes below |

The plugin reads three attributes from the official UI. If a future dsh release
renames them, the menu and hover button go quiet rather than erroring, and the
fix is a one-line change in `src/client/controller.js`:

| Attribute | Owner | Used for |
|---|---|---|
| `data-files-entry` | `dsh-client-ui-sidebar-files` | `file` / `directory` / `other` |
| `data-files-path` | `dsh-client-ui-sidebar-files` | the row's absolute path |
| `data-sidebar-right-session` | `dsh-client-ui-sidebar-right` | which Session the panel shows |

The root blank area and the root path use two more attributes on the tree
container, likewise stable: `data-files-state="tree"`, `data-files-root`, and
`data-files-body`.

> **What `0.2.2` changed:** it removed the tree's header row (and with it
> `data-path-label`), and added an official `contextMenus` service. The plugin
> never depended on the header — the root path comes from the container — so it
> is unaffected. The new service is an optional alternative path; the plugin
> still draws its own menu, because that keeps it free of a hard dependency on a
> service that does not exist in `0.2.1`.

---

The plugin runs in the browser, but every filesystem operation runs on the
**host machine** through `/api/dsh-file-extension/*` routes. So "can it reveal /
save / trash" depends on the host, not on the browser.

| Feature | Desktop app | Web (host on the same machine) | Web (host elsewhere) |
|---|---|---|---|
| Reveal in File Manager | ✅ native | ✅ via the host's desktop opener | ❌ greyed out with a tooltip |
| Add to Conversation | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ |
| Open in New Tab | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ |
| Save As | ✅ native folder picker + Host write | ✅ native folder picker + Host write | ⬇️ falls back to a browser download (bounded at 32 MiB, with a size warning) |
| Copy paths | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ |
| Rename | ✅ Host filesystem | ✅ Host filesystem | ✅ Host filesystem |
| Delete | ♻️ recycle bin | ♻️ recycle bin | ♻️ depends on the host OS |

The **Save As** dialog is drawn by the plugin: both the file name and the
**destination folder** are editable fields, and the **Choose…** button calls the
host's own directory dialog (the native folder chooser on desktop). When that
dialog does not answer — it opened behind the window, or the host is a plain Web
deployment — the button immediately shows "Waiting for the host…" and explains
itself after 30 seconds; typing a folder path always works, and an empty folder
saves beside the original. Save As therefore stays usable even when the host
dialog is not.

| Platform | Implementation | Verified |
|---|---|---|
| Windows | `Microsoft.VisualBasic.FileIO.FileSystem` with `SendToRecycleBin` via PowerShell | ✅ file and folder both confirmed present in `D:\$Recycle.Bin` |
| macOS | `trash` CLI when installed, else a Finder AppleScript | not tested on this machine |
| Linux | FreeDesktop Trash spec (`~/.local/share/Trash` with `.trashinfo`) | not tested on this machine |

When the recycle bin is genuinely unreachable, the plugin **does not silently
delete**. It re-opens the confirmation with the red warning
"This action permanently deletes the file and cannot be undone." and requires a
second explicit confirmation.

---

1. **DOM coupling.** dsh has no row-level extension point for the file tree, so
   the plugin attaches to the row attributes listed under
   [Compatibility](#compatibility). This is the only coupling, and it is
   deliberately narrow.
2. **Inline rename is an overlay.** The editor is absolutely positioned over the
   row (the official row cannot host an injected component). It follows the row
   through scroll and refresh, and closes if the row disappears.
3. **Host-side recycle bin.** Deletion happens on the machine running the host
   process, not the machine running the browser.
4. **Browser download cap.** The download fallback refuses files above 32 MiB by
   default (`maxDownloadBytes` in the plugin config).
5. **`open-in-app` is required for reveal.** If a deployment omits the
   `session.openWorkspacePath` Remote, the reveal row stays disabled.
6. **Two files can race.** The Host refuses to overwrite an existing target, but
   a file created between the check and the write can still be replaced by the
   OS-level copy. This is the same window every save dialog has.
7. **The update check needs to reach GitHub.** Behind a TLS-intercepting proxy
   (common on corporate network

> **A failed check is never "you are up to date."** This was a real defect: the
   > failure response hard-coded `hasUpdate: false`, so the dialog said "you are
   > on the latest release" — turning "unknown" into "nothing to install" and
   > hiding the very failure the user needed to see. Failures now return
   > `hasUpdate: null` / `checked: false`, and the dialog states that the check
   > could not be completed, together with the reason.
8. **In-place update depends on the deployment.** The update is delegated to the
   Harness's `pluginManager`; when it is unavailable or refuses (hot reload active,
   package files locked by the process), the dialog shows a copyable command
   rather than claiming success.
9. **Anonymous GitHub API rate limit.** The check uses the public GitHub API,
   which allows 60 requests/hour per egress IP without a token. Repeated
   "check again" clicks can hit that limit; the dialog then says
   "GitHub refused the request (HTTP 403) — the API rate limit was reached, try
   again later" instead of treating it as up to date.

`cordis.patch.yml` inserts one loader row:

```yaml
- insert:
    - id: dsh-file-extension
      name: dsh-file-extension
```

`package.json` points at it with `dsh.bundle.patch`, so
`dsh plugin add` installs the dependency **and** registers the row in one step.

| Field | Value | Why |
|---|---|---|
| `exports["."]` | `./lib/index.js` | the loader `import()`s the package root for the Host half |
| `exports["./client"]` | `./lib/client.js` | the browser module system serves this bundle |
| `dsh.bundle.patch` | `./cordis.patch.yml` | makes the package a bundle |
| `dsh.client.platform` | `web` | it is a browser plugin |
| `dsh.client.immediately` | `true` | load it at boot, not on first use |
| `dsh.client.inject` | slots, sidebar-right, conversation, locale, remotes, session-controller | activation ordering only |
| `files` | `lib/`, patch, locale, icon, README, LICENSE | keeps the published tarball small |
| `peerDependencies` | all `@deepseek-ai/*` and `react` | nothing is bundled twice |

The row lands in the profile's `cordis.patch.yml`-composed tree. Verify with:

```bash
dsh --profile web --dump-config | grep -A2 "dsh-file-extension"
```

| Piece | Where | Lifetime |
|---|---|---|
| Host routes `/api/dsh-file-extension/*` | `ctx.webServer.register` inside `ctx.effect` | removed on unload |
| Context menu, dialogs, toasts | `shell.overlay` slot | removed on unload |
| Composer `inputActions` capture | `conversation.input.dock` slot | removed on unload |
| Row listeners + `MutationObserver` | `document`, inside `ctx.effect` | removed on unload |
| Stylesheet | one `<style data-plugin="dsh-file-extension">` | removed on unload |
| Locale dictionaries | `ctx.locale.register` | removed on unload |

Every route is authenticated with `ctx.connection.requestRejection`, so a plugin
route is exactly as protected as an official one — an unauthenticated request
gets `401`.

```bash
npm install          # esbuild only
node build.mjs       # src/ -> lib/
```

`src/host/` is a normal ES module. `src/client/` is bundled to CommonJS and
wrapped in `window.__ModuleLoader__.load({ id, factory })`, because the browser
module system only registers factories. `react` and the platform module table are
left external.

```
src/host/
  index.js       apply(), Config, HTTP routes, auth
  contract.js    shared codes, name validation, copy-name helper
  fsops.js       stat / rename / remove / copy / download
